newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RIEDLE'S LIVERPOOL MOVE STILL ON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIEDLE'S LIVERPOOL MOVE STILL ON.

text.p: Liverpool look to have beaten off English premier league rivals Newcastle in the chase for Borussia Dortmund striker Karl-Heinz Riedle.
Dortmund's sports director Ottmar Hitzfeld, who guided the Germans to a 3-1 European Cup final win over Juventus in May, said: "The deal with Liverpool is just about done.
"Nothing will actually happen today -- but tomorrow or the day after could be different."
Liverpool denied an interest in Riedle earlier this week, despite Hitzfeld claiming an approach had been made, but look now to be close to clinching the signing.
According to press reports, the 31-year-old Riedle -- who scored twice in the Champions' League final -- is due in Liverpool on Thursday to sign a 1.8-million-pound ($2.9-million) deal.

Newcastle boss Kenny Dalglish is believed to have wanted Riedle as a short-term replacement for the injured Alan Shearer while Liverpool manager Roy Evans wants the German to replace Stan Collymore who left Anfield for Aston Villa in a seven-million-pound ($11.7-million) deal.
